content.tex: B MODELLING HOW MUCH GRASS CAN THE GOAT EAT? (20 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 45 minutes on this part.
A farmer owns a goat and a large field with lots of grass in it.

parts.text: The farmer ties the goat to a point in the field with a rope that is 10 m long. Find the area of grass that the goat can eat. ......................................................

content.tex: The farmer ties the goat to a point in the field with a rope that is \(10m\) long.
Find the area of grass that the goat can eat.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) With the same 10 m rope, she ties the goat to an outside corner of a barn of length 25 m and width 15 m. Find the area of grass that the goat can eat. ......................................................

content.tex: With the same \(10m\) rope, she ties the goat to an outside corner of a barn of length \(25m\) and width 15m.
Find the area of grass that the goat can eat.

parts.text: (b) With a 20 m rope she ties the goat to the same corner of the barn. Explain what happens when the goat continues past point G.
